tasks.label: setup
tasks.command: python -m pip install -e ".[dev]" && cd frontend && npm install

tasks.label: lint
tasks.command: python -m ruff check algorithms model tests benchmarks *.py && python -m mypy

tasks.label: format
tasks.command: python -m ruff format algorithms model tests benchmarks *.py && python -m ruff check --fix algorithms model tests benchmarks *.py

tasks.label: run app (build UI + serve)
tasks.command: cd frontend && npm run build && cd .. && python -m uvicorn api:app --port 8000
